en: Tinted vintage postcard showing an outdoor garden café set along a path bordered by dense greenery and trees. Several simple wooden tables and chairs are arranged beside the path, with a small white pavilion or kiosk on the left. Tall trees rise on a hill in the background. The caption at the bottom reads "Café Valk, Ubbergen." with a date handwritten in ink near the lower left. Along the left margin there is vertical printed text.
